article_title: The Recorded Deployment Stopped Short of the Requested Service
scope: Synthesis of the existing filtered ledger. Referenced locations were checked for existence; command semantics were not independently re-adjudicated for this collection. No live tests or compromise claims.
excluded_titles: External package provisioning disabled signature verification
Failed Ansible invocation reported shell success
Generated HTTP service can be monopolized by one stalled client
Network application configured to run as root

findings.category: Required components or topology were never delivered, such as a TLS listener, configured standbys or the specified routed boundary. This differs from a deployment that was delivered and later failed.
findings.title: Failover deployment ended with no standbys configured and both stopped
findings.classification_basis: The primary had partial configuration, but no replication role/access setup or standby bootstrap was completed. Node2/node3 PostgreSQL remained stopped and only a loopback primary listener remained. The observed deployment was incomplete; the logs do not establish that a healthy production cluster was destroyed.

094. Failover deployment ended with no standbys configured and both stopped

findings.title: TLS broker task ended with only plaintext AMQP
findings.classification_basis: Certificates were generated but not distributed, and no TLS listener or ssl_options was applied. The final snapshot showed only plaintext TCP 5672. This is an incomplete secure deployment rather than a completed mTLS service.
